page_note: Page is dominated by cosmological substrate teaching: the earthquake at the third bone of the Omophoros, Jesus's descent to support the lower shoulders, and the correspondential mapping of this cosmic event onto the human body (Sin, Old Man, Mind of Light). The substrate is built as a triad of correspondences: cosmic Zone watch → cosmic body earthquake → human body disturbance. Two clear editorial seams: i=12 ('Then said the Apostle') interrupts the teaching to attribute, and i=30 ('But you, know in this manner') pivots to audience address. Editorial fatigue is real but moderate — the second half retains substantial cosmological content within a hortatory frame.
